item.title: [Another] Dutch Data Breach: 800k Citizens' PII Leaked - The Moloch
item.description: The Netherlands is really going through it with the data leak stuff. Another dump of Dutch citizens’ personally identifiable information (PII) data just dropped a few hours ago.

item.title: It's Time To Talk About The TikTok Ban - The Moloch
item.description: There's been a lot of back-and-forth about what's driving the recently enacted-then-retracted TikTok ban. It's important to remember that the fundamental reasoning for "why" (or as some would say, the excuse given) is one of national cybersecurity. But does that hold up?

item.description: Today, on what marks the 58th day of protests against the new Georgian government, an interesting turn of events caused Tblisi's bus system to suspend fares.

item.title: Update From OrangeCon 2025 - The Moloch
item.description: ...However, one event had passed me by. A very new convention called OrangeCon, which had only run for the first time that year. When the opportunity arose to try and attend this past Friday, I had to jump at the chance, and I'm glad that I did!

item.title: Infrastructure Destruction Squad (Dark Engine?) Targets Latvian Entities - The Moloch
item.description: On September 9, 2025, pro-Russian hacktivist group Infrastructure Destruction Squad (IDS) claimed intrusions into Latvian ICS, government systems, and even Antigua & Barbuda’s customs infrastructure. But are their dramatic claims—tied to a mysterious 'Sergey' and framed as revenge—credible? We break down the alleged breaches, separate likely exaggerations from plausible access, and explore why Latvia remains a prime target for hacktivist narratives, even if true operational impact is unlikely.

item.title: Canadian ICS Breach by Unidentified 'Hacktivists'. Hmm. - The Moloch
item.description: I am typically extremely skeptical of claims by hacktivists that they have somehow breached ICS/SCADA systems, but, it seems to have happened in Canada.
